summary:
I re-ran the ui subagent, which the user may have accidentally cancelled. When I started, src/ui/ only held the placeholder index.tsx, so I built the whole kit from scratch. It is finished and documented, so feature agents can start now.

- **Kit:** every requested component, plus a few extras feature agents will need: BottomBar, PauseIcon, and ListRow `children` for "label + value, slider below" rows. Each lives in its own co-located file with its own CSS and is re-exported from src/ui/index.tsx. The old exports (Icon, IconComponent, AppFrame, Page, TabBar, ToastProvider, useToast) still work with the same signatures.
- **Signature pieces:**
  - Vinyl is a black record with fine grooves and a fixed highlight that stays put while the record turns, a cream center label, and a soft raised round base.
  - It has a thin accent progress ring and a drawn tonearm that swings onto the record over about 1.1 s when set to 'play'.
  - Spinning speeds up and slows down smoothly, never jumps, and stops entirely with reduced motion.
  - Waveform is drawn on a canvas so bars are crisp, follows the theme, and dims bars outside the selection.
  - LiveBars is the level meter: center bars taller, quick to rise and slow to fall.
- **Tokens and styling:** extra tokens (vinyl, controls, layers) are in src/ui/kit.css with light and dark values. I rewrote src/styles/global.css (resets, icon stroke, scroll lock, type and layout utility classes, a quieter page background around the app column on desktop).
- **App.tsx (shell wiring only):** push screens now slide forward on normal navigation and backward on back. A DEV-only `/__kit` gallery is loaded lazily and is not in the production build; I checked the built JS and CSS.
- **Gallery and demos:** `#/__kit` shows every component, using the real cover images from the assets agent. Two layout demos validate the recipes: `#/__kit?demo=screen` (push screen with a bottom action bar) and `#/__kit?demo=tab` (tab screen).
- **Docs:** docs/UI-KIT.md has a one-line example for every export, the screen recipes (tab screen, push screen with bottom actions, settings rows), the spacing scale, the utility classes and the extra tokens.
- **Screenshots:** I reviewed the gallery, the demos and all overlays in light and dark and iterated until they matched the references: soft cards, ink pills, raised round transport controls, glass tab bar, lots of empty space.
- **Client feedback:** docs/CLIENT-FEEDBACK.md had no entries at the start or at the end, so there was nothing to apply.
public_api_notes:
Import everything from src/ui (e.g. `import { Page, TopBar, Button } from '../../ui'`). Full reference with an example per export: docs/UI-KIT.md. Live gallery (dev server only): `#/__kit`, plus `#/__kit?demo=screen` and `#/__kit?demo=tab`.

Gotchas for feature agents:
1. **Page defaults to `variant='push'`.** Tab screens (/, /library, /settings) must use `<Page variant="tab" tabBar>` with `<TopBar large title="…" right={…} />`. Push screens use `<TopBar left={<BackButton fallback="/library" />} title subtitle right sticky? />`.
2. **Page is a full-height flex column.** `BottomBar` must be its LAST child: it sits at the bottom when content is short and sticks above the safe area when content scrolls. Never use `position: fixed` inside a Page (pages are transformed during transitions); overlays already portal to `<body>`. New screens scroll to top on mount (`keepScroll` opts out).
3. **There is no bare pause icon in Untitled UI.** Use `PauseIcon` from the kit (the Untitled `Equal` glyph rotated 90°).
4. **Button:** variant `ink | accent | secondary | ghost | danger`, size `sm | md | lg` (36 / 44 / 56). Also takes `icon`, `iconRight`, `full`, `loading` and `ref`.
5. **IconButton:** `label` is required; variant `ghost | surface | neu | ink | accent`; size `sm | md | lg | xl` (36 / 44 / 56 / 76). `active` changes the look only; `pressed` sets aria-pressed for toggles.
6. **Overlays (Sheet, ActionSheet, ConfirmDialog, PromptDialog):** keep them mounted and toggle `open` so the exit animation plays. They lock page scroll (`html.ui-scroll-locked`), trap focus and close on Escape. Drag-to-dismiss starts from the sheet's handle/header only.
   - ActionSheet runs `onSelect` after the sheet has left, so it is safe to open a dialog from it.
   - ConfirmDialog and PromptDialog: the caller closes them in `onConfirm` / `onCancel`. PromptDialog's `onConfirm` receives a trimmed, non-empty string.
7. **Toasts:** `useToast().show(message, { tone?: 'neutral'|'success'|'danger', duration? })`. Same API as the old placeholder.
8. **Sliders:** `Slider` / `RangeSlider` `onChange` fires on every move; `onChangeEnd` fires once on release (use it for rebuilding the score). RangeSlider takes `minGap` and `labels` (default `['inicio','fin']`).
9. **ListRow:** becomes a `<button>` when it has `onClick`; don't put interactive elements in `trailing` of a clickable row. `children` adds full-width content under the title line (non-clickable rows only), e.g. a Slider. SettingsGroup draws hairlines between its direct children; inside a Sheet its card turns grey automatically.
10. **Long press:** `useLongPress(cb, ms)` returns handlers you spread onto Card or ListRow (both accept them). It swallows the click that follows a long press; right-click also triggers it.
11. **Cover:** `<Cover src={getCover(doc.coverId)?.src} seed={doc.id} size={…} shape='rounded'|'circle' spinning? layoutId? />`. Without `src`, or if the image fails, it draws a soft placeholder from `seed`. Images fade in on load.
12. **Vinyl:** `<Vinyl size spinning speed='slow'|'normal' tonearm='hidden'|'rest'|'play' progress={0..1} label | labelSrc plinth onClick ariaLabel />`. The record, base and tonearm all fit inside `size` x `size`.
13. **Waveform:** `<Waveform peaks progress? selection?=[s,e] (0..1) height barWidth gap normalize animate />`. Use `animate={false}` for live data that grows while recording.
14. **LiveBars:** `<LiveBars level active bars height className />`. Bar color is `currentColor` (default `--ink-2`).
15. **ProgressRing:** `value`, `size`, `stroke`, `indeterminate`, centered `children`. **Spinner:** `size`; pass `label` to have it announced.
16. **Motion presets:** `ease`, `spring`, `softSpring`, `durations`, `tapScale`, `pageVariants`, `fadeUp(delay)`, `listContainer` / `listItem` (stagger 0.04 s). `useReducedMotionPref()` combines the OS setting with settings.reduceMotion; AppFrame also mirrors it to `<html data-reduce-motion>` for CSS animations.
17. **Utility classes (global.css):** `ui-t-display|title|h2|body|caption|micro`, `ui-t-muted`, `ui-t-faint`, `tabular`, `visually-hidden`, `ui-stack` (`--gap`), `ui-row-flex`, `ui-spacer`. global.css also resets `ul`/`ol` (no bullets, no padding) and heading/paragraph margins.
18. **Extra tokens (src/ui/kit.css, light and dark):** `--raised --knob --track --fill --press --glass-border --glass-blur --bar-bg --bg-top --bg-bottom --page-outer --danger-ink --shadow-ink(-sm) --shadow-accent --shadow-knob --shadow-float`, the vinyl / arm / metal tokens, `--cover-staff --cover-note --cover-tone-0..5`, `--wave --wave-dim`, and z-index layers `--z-bar 20`, `--z-tabbar 40`, `--z-sheet 60`, `--z-dialog 70`, `--z-toast 90`.
19. **BackButton:** goes back with `navigate(-1)` when react-router's `history.state.idx > 0`; otherwise it replaces to `fallback` (deep links).

requests.request: src/features/home/HomeScreen.tsx: render the tab screen as <Page variant="tab" tabBar> with <TopBar large …>. The default variant is 'push', which slides horizontally and leaves no room for the tab bar.

src/features/library/LibraryScreen.tsx: use <Page variant="tab" tabBar> + <TopBar large title="Biblioteca" …>. The #/__kit?demo=tab skeleton (SearchField, ChipRow, Card+ListRow with Cover, useLongPress -> ActionSheet) is the suggested starting point.

src/features/settings/SettingsScreen.tsx: use <Page variant="tab" tabBar> + <TopBar large title="Ajustes">. Build rows with SettingsGroup + ListRow (trailing Toggle/Segmented, children Slider, chevron, tone="danger"). AboutScreen is a push screen: <TopBar left={<BackButton fallback="/settings" />} …>.

App.tsx useTheme (foundation logic, which I did not touch): the theme-color meta is only recomputed when settings.theme changes. With theme='system', switching the OS between light and dark leaves the old color until reload. Suggest also listening to matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').

known_issues: KitGallery.tsx is 448 lines, a little over the ~400-line guideline. It is DEV-only and not in the production bundle.
Sheets can only be dragged down from the handle/header area, not from the content when it is scrolled to the top, so the content can scroll freely.
Overlays trap Tab focus and lock scroll but do not set `inert` on the background, so a screen reader's virtual cursor could still reach background content.
Cover's layoutId prop is wired but untested across routes: AnimatePresence mode="wait" unmounts the old page before the new one mounts, so a cover-to-viewer shared transition may not animate.
When the in-app reduce-motion setting is on, motion's own dev-only warning 'You have Reduced Motion enabled…' appears in the console. It is informational, not an error.
BackButton relies on react-router's history.state.idx. Direct URL edits and deep links go to `fallback` instead of history back (intended).
verification:
- **Typecheck:** `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 for the whole project, run several times during the work and at the end.
- **Build:** `npm run build` (tsc + vite build) succeeds, with 134 PWA precache entries. A separate scratch build confirmed that no KitGallery JS strings or `.kit-*` CSS reach production.
- **Interaction checks** (puppeteer script /tmp/claude-11397/kitcheck.mjs, run on my own dev server at port 5181): 27 of 28 pass.
  - Sheet: opens, moves focus inside, traps Tab, locks and unlocks page scroll, closes on Escape, restores focus, and dismisses on drag-down.
  - ActionSheet: selecting an action closes it and then opens the PromptDialog.
  - PromptDialog: autofocuses and selects the text; Enter submits. The toast shows and auto-dismisses.
  - ConfirmDialog is an alertdialog, focuses Cancelar for danger, and closes on Escape.
  - Segmented arrow keys, Stepper press-and-hold (96 to 104) and Home, Toggle and Slider keyboard all work.
  - Tab navigation and the tab bar's visibility work; reduce-motion is mirrored to `<html>`.
  - The one failure is the test's own setup: changing the hash directly is a deep link, so BackButton correctly used its fallback.
- **Screenshots:** reviewed at 390x844 @2x in light and dark (gallery full page, vinyl, screen and tab skeletons, sheet, action sheet, confirm, prompt, toast), plus a 1280px desktop check of the app column.
- **Console and cleanup:** no console errors. The dev server on port 5181 is stopped.
